periods.method: Chronological split of the trading days: the first 60% in-sample, the next 20% validation, the last 20% out-of-sample. Trades are assigned to the segment in which they exited. Walk-forward folds are consecutive equal blocks used to check whether results are consistent over time.

definitions.ending_equity: Cash plus open positions valued at their last price, at the end of the test (USD).
definitions.net_pnl: Ending equity minus starting capital: the overall result after all costs (USD).
definitions.total_return_pct: Net P&L as a percentage of starting capital.
definitions.realized_pnl: Profit or loss locked in by sales during the test, after commissions (USD).
definitions.unrealized_pnl: Paper profit or loss on positions still open at the end, at their last price (USD).
definitions.gross_profits: Sum of the net results of all winning completed trades (USD).
definitions.gross_losses: Sum of the net results of all losing completed trades (USD, shown negative).
definitions.completed_trades: Round trips that were fully closed during the test. A position sold in pieces counts once.
definitions.open_positions_end: Positions still held when the test ended.
definitions.winning_trades: Completed trades with a net result above zero.
definitions.losing_trades: Completed trades with a net result below zero.
definitions.breakeven_trades: Completed trades with a net result of exactly zero (to the cent).
definitions.win_rate_pct: Winning trades as a percentage of completed trades.
definitions.avg_win: Average net result of the winning trades (USD).
definitions.avg_loss: Average net result of the losing trades (USD).
definitions.profit_factor: Gross profits divided by the absolute value of gross losses. Above 1 means winners outweighed losers.
definitions.expectancy: Average net result per completed trade (USD).
definitions.avg_r: Average result per trade in R, where 1R is the money that would have been lost at the initial stop.
definitions.max_drawdown_pct: Largest percentage fall in equity from a previous peak, measured every 5 minutes.
definitions.max_drawdown_usd: The same largest fall, in dollars.
definitions.avg_holding_minutes: Average time between the first entry fill and the final exit (minutes).
definitions.total_commission: All simulated commissions (IBKR Fixed pricing model, USD).
definitions.total_slippage: Estimated cost of spread and slippage, already included in the fill prices (USD).
definitions.cost_share_of_gross_pct: Commissions plus slippage as a percentage of the absolute gross (pre-cost) P&L.
definitions.avg_exposure_pct: Average value of open positions as a percentage of equity, across all 5-minute marks.
definitions.max_exposure_pct: Highest value of open positions as a percentage of equity.
definitions.time_in_market_pct: Share of 5-minute marks with at least one open position.
definitions.max_concurrent_positions: Most positions held at the same time.
definitions.max_consecutive_losses: Longest run of losing completed trades in a row.
definitions.top3_share_of_net_pct: Net P&L of the three best trades as a percentage of total net P&L (shows dependence on a few trades).
definitions.daily_volatility_pct: Standard deviation of daily returns (percent of the day's starting equity).
definitions.sharpe_like: Average daily return divided by its standard deviation, times the square root of 252. A rough risk-adjusted figure; not reliable on short samples.
definitions.benchmark_return_pct: Buy-and-hold return of the benchmark ETF over the same days (first open to last close).
definitions.mean_trade_ci95: Range that would contain the average trade result in 95% of bootstrap resamples of the trades. If it includes 0, the average could plausibly be zero.
definitions.days_with_trades: Trading days on which at least one trade was completed.
definitions.days_without_trades: Trading days with data but no completed trade.

research_questions.question: Is the number of trades large enough to judge the strategy?
research_questions.evidence: 30 completed trades; this project's minimum for an assessment is 30.
research_questions.next_step: Keep checking that results hold in each validation segment.

research_questions.question: Does the data cover enough market history and conditions?
research_questions.evidence: 85 trading days (2026-06-22 to 2026-10-20), provider ibkr, data status warn, 0 symbol-days without 5-minute data.
research_questions.next_step: Test at least one full year, including a falling market, before relying on any result.

research_questions.question: Are transaction costs a material part of the result?
research_questions.evidence: Commissions $125.50 and estimated spread/slippage $731.93 = 12.8% of the absolute gross P&L.
research_questions.next_step: Compare with the stress run below and with actual paper-trading fills.

research_questions.question: Are results concentrated in a few trades?
research_questions.evidence: The three best trades produced 45.6% of the net P&L.
research_questions.next_step: Check whether removing the best few trades changes the conclusion.

research_questions.question: Do in-sample results carry over to unseen (out-of-sample) days?
research_questions.evidence: In-sample $7,481.44 over 21 trades; out-of-sample -$1,148.93 over 3 trades.
research_questions.next_step: Treat a positive in-sample result that fails out-of-sample as a warning sign.

research_questions.question: Does performance vary a lot between periods (market regimes)?
research_questions.next_step: Look at what the market did in the losing periods (trend, volatility).

research_questions.question: Has this dataset been used to try many rule variants?
research_questions.evidence: 4 rule variant(s) and 4 run(s) have been evaluated on this exact dataset.
research_questions.next_step: The more variants are tried on the same data, the more the best one is flattered by chance; confirm any choice on data not used to choose it.

research_questions.question: How many trades depend on uncertain intrabar assumptions?
research_questions.evidence: 0 ambiguous bar(s) (stop assumed first), 0 gap(s) through a stop, 0 entr(ies) filled below the stop, 0 partially filled entr(ies).
research_questions.next_step: 1-minute data would settle most of these; the conservative choice already lowers results.

research_questions.question: Which entry checks block the most candidates?
research_questions.evidence: 2176 evaluations of watchlist stocks; 31 passed. Most frequent blocking checks: P1 (1345), T1 (800).
research_questions.next_step: A check that blocks almost everything may deserve an experiment, judged on validation data.

research_questions.question: How do trades end?
research_questions.evidence: exit signal: price above SMA: 29, initial stop: 1.
research_questions.next_step: Many initial-stop exits can mean entries are late or stops are tight; test both separately.

research_questions.question: How does the result compare with simply holding the market?
research_questions.evidence: Strategy 0.58% vs buy-and-hold SPY 2.86% over the same days, while the strategy was invested on average 3.5% of its equity.
research_questions.next_step: Returns are not risk-matched: the strategy is mostly in cash.

summary: What it does: Macro Swing ETF (Multi-day sector pullbacks - holds positions overnight) trades 1d signals, holding overnight. Entries between 15:45 and 15:55 New York time need every check to pass (T1, P1); the initial stop is atr_multiple(period=14, multiple=3.0); exits: close_above_sma(period=5, at_et=15:50), time_stop(days=10, at_et=15:50).
Period tested: 2026-06-22 to 2026-10-20 (85 trading days; requested 2026-06-22 to 2026-10-20).
Data: ibkr, 11 of 11 symbols had daily data; 935 symbol-days of 5m bars were used; data status: warn.
Simulated trades: 30 completed, 1 still open at the end.
Measured result: net P&L $5,768.34 (0.58% of $1,000,000.00 starting capital), win rate 73.3% of completed trades, profit factor 3.337.
Largest decline: 0.37% ($3,694.86) from a previous equity peak.
Costs: included. Commissions $125.50; estimated spread and slippage $731.93 are built into the fill prices.
Unseen data: the last part of the period was kept as an out-of-sample check: 3 trades, -$1,148.93.

computed_findings: Over this period the simulation produced 30 completed trades and a net result of $5,768.34 after costs.
The bootstrap range of the average trade ($58.95 to $388.04) does not include zero in this sample.
concerns: Does the data cover enough market history and conditions? 85 trading days (2026-06-22 to 2026-10-20), provider ibkr, data status warn, 0 symbol-days without 5-minute data.
Do in-sample results carry over to unseen (out-of-sample) days? In-sample $7,481.44 over 21 trades; out-of-sample -$1,148.93 over 3 trades.
not_established: That the strategy will be profitable in the future: historical simulation results do not guarantee future performance.
That live fills would match the simulated fills (no historical bid/ask; fills are modelled).
That the result is statistically significant: no significance test is claimed here.
assumptions: Quote proxy: ask/bid = last close +/- 2.0 bps; extra slippage 2.0 bps on market-like fills.
Ambiguous bars: when a stop and a profit target could both have been reached in one bar, the stop is assumed first (conservative).
Timing: orders sent by a pass fill from the next bar; an off-grid force close (15:51 on 5-minute bars) therefore sells from the 15:55 bar.
Buying power: cash x 1.0 (the paper account's margin may allow more).
Universe: today's index members from the fallback list, so stocks that left the index are missing (survivorship bias, usually flattering).
assessment.data_sufficiency: 85 trading days and 30 trades. This is not enough data for a reliable evaluation; treat every figure as illustrative.
assessment.costs_and_execution: No execution stress test was run.
further_tests: Test at least one full year, including a falling market, before relying on any result.
Treat a positive in-sample result that fails out-of-sample as a warning sign.
assessment.label: Automated interpretation: generated by fixed rules from the metrics and validation results above. It is not investment advice and not a statistical test.

rules_explained.label: Strategy
rules_explained.explanation: Multi-day sector pullbacks - holds positions overnight

rules_explained.label: Timeframe
rules_explained.explanation: Signals use completed daily bars and today's price near the close.

rules_explained.label: Holding period
rules_explained.explanation: Positions are held overnight on a protective stop until an exit signal.

rules_explained.value: XLK, XLF, XLE, XLV, XLI, XLY, XLP, XLU, XLB, XLRE, XLC
rules_explained.label: Universe
rules_explained.explanation: These symbols are scanned.

rules_explained.label: First entry time
rules_explained.explanation: No entries before 15:45 New York time.

rules_explained.label: Last entry time
rules_explained.explanation: No new entries after 15:55; unfilled entry orders expire a minute later.

rules_explained.label: Force close
rules_explained.explanation: No end-of-day close: positions can be held overnight.

rules_explained.label: Entry check T1
rules_explained.explanation: Today's price (1d: the live price; intraday: the last completed close) is above the simple moving average of daily closes including today's.

rules_explained.label: Entry check P1
rules_explained.explanation: Wilder RSI of daily closes including today's is below max (a pullback).

rules_explained.label: Initial stop
rules_explained.explanation: `multiple` x the Wilder ATR(period) of daily bars below today's price.

rules_explained.label: Exit
rules_explained.explanation: Exit when today's live price is above the SMA(period) of daily closes including today's (from at_et on, e.g. 15:50 for a close-based rule).

rules_explained.label: Exit
rules_explained.explanation: Exit after `days` trading days held (multi-day) or `minutes` (intraday), from at_et on if given. Exactly one of days / minutes.

rules_explained.label: Risk per trade
rules_explained.explanation: At most 1.0% of the account can be lost if the initial stop is hit.

rules_explained.label: Position size
rules_explained.explanation: One position is at most 10% of the account.

rules_explained.label: Concurrent positions
rules_explained.explanation: At most 3 positions (including unfilled entries) at once.

rules_explained.label: Commission check
rules_explained.explanation: A trade is skipped if its estimated commissions exceed 1.0% of the money at risk.

rules_explained.label: Drawdown breaker
rules_explained.explanation: After a $6,000 fall in cumulative P&L, entries stop until someone re-arms the breaker by hand.

rules_explained.label: Share cap
rules_explained.explanation: One entry order is at most 1000 shares.

rules_explained.label: Order value cap
rules_explained.explanation: One entry order is at most $30,000.

rules_explained.label: Entries per day
rules_explained.explanation: At most 5 entry orders per day.

rules_explained.label: Working orders
rules_explained.explanation: At most 3 unfilled entry/exit orders at once (stops not counted).

rules_explained.label: Daily loss halt
rules_explained.explanation: After losing $2,000 in a day, no new entries that day.
